text.description_html:
Michael Healy MH1151, 4-1/2 Inch Blue Crab Door Knocker in Nickel Sliver

This Blue Crab Door Knocker is made out of sandcast brass and has a nickel silver finish. The nickel silver finish is unique to Michael Healy Designs; it is created by combining polished nickel with satin highlights that accent this front door knocker's details for a contemporary look. The 4-1/2 Inch Nickel Silver Crab Door Knocker comes packaged with the mounting hardware needed to surface mount it. It has 7/8 inch mounting centers. This 4-1/2 Inch Blue Crab Door Knocker in Nickel Silver is great for any vacation home or a home by the seaside.

Each door knocker is beautifully packed and is signed and dated by the artist, Michael Healy.

Available in 3 finishes:
Nickel Silver Polished Brass and Brown Patina Oiled Bronze

Features and Specifications of the Blue Crab Front Door Knocker:

  • Material: Sandcast Brass
  • Finish: Nickel Silver
  • Height: 4-1/2"
  • Width: 5-1/4"
  • Mounting Hole Centers: 7/8"
  • Projection Off Door: 1-3/4"
  • Mounting: Surface Mounting
  • Comes packaged with mounting hardware.

Sold Individually
